nodes.name: edit.html
nodes.summary: Main SoA editing page rendering the study metadata form, activities/instances CRUD sections, and the large timeline-aware activity/instance matrix with per-cell toggling, footnotes management, and Excel/HTML export links.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a local Jinja2 macro `epoch_th` for rendering merged epoch header cells, and embeds a substantial vanilla-JS block for timeline switching, drag-and-drop reordering, and collapse-state persistence via localStorage/sessionStorage.

nodes.name: element_audit_section.html
nodes.summary: Small collapsible partial rendering the most recent StudyElement audit trail entries (action, timestamp, before/after JSON) in a table.

nodes.name: elements.html
nodes.summary: CRUD page for StudyElement records, letting users create elements and edit their name, label, description, transition start/end rules, and linked interventions.

nodes.name: encounters.html
nodes.summary: CRUD page for Encounter (visit) records with fields for scheduled timing, environmental setting, contact mode, and transition rules, plus drag-free up/down row reordering with a save-order action.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes embedded JS for row-based reordering (moveEncounterRow) and posting the new order via XMLHttpRequest to a reorder endpoint.

nodes.name: epochs.html
nodes.summary: CRUD page for StudyEpoch records supporting create, inline edit/save, delete, and manual up/down reordering with an order-persistence endpoint call.

nodes.name: estimands.html
nodes.summary: Page for managing study Estimands and Indications, combining the estimands and indications partials with HTMX-driven add forms for each.

nodes.name: estimands_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX-swappable partial listing estimands with nested subsections for linked variables of interest (endpoints), linked interventions, and intercurrent events, each with inline link/add/delete forms.

nodes.name: freeze_modal.html
nodes.summary: Standalone modal fragment rendered directly by the freezes router for three modes: viewing a frozen snapshot, diffing two snapshots (visits/activities/cells/concepts/USDM entities), and previewing a rollback.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a local Jinja2 macro `cell_axis_label` to normalize display of matrix cell axis labels (instance vs. visit) across the view/diff/rollback-preview modes.

nodes.name: freezes.html
nodes.summary: Snapshot/amendment management page listing frozen SoA versions with view, rollback-preview, JSON download, and delete actions, plus a version comparison selector and audit log links.

nodes.name: help.html
nodes.summary: Static step-by-step help guide describing the workflow for building an SoA matrix, from creating a study through epochs, arms, elements, encounters, and USDM JSON generation.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Landing page listing existing studies with create-new-study and import-from-bundle forms, plus a confirmation modal (typed Study ID/name match) for deleting a study.
nodes.languageNotes: Embedded JS implements a type-to-confirm delete-study modal that validates the typed value against the study's ID (or name when no ID is set) before enabling the delete button.

nodes.name: indications_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX-swappable partial listing study Indications with a rare-disease flag and a nested per-indication Codes subsection supporting add/delete of coded terms.

nodes.name: instances.html
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper page that extends the base layout and includes the shared scheduled-instances section partial.

nodes.name: objectives.html
nodes.summary: CRUD page for Objectives and their child Endpoints, grouping endpoints under their parent objective and surfacing a separate reassignment table for orphaned endpoints.

nodes.name: organizations_oob_response.html
nodes.summary: HTMX out-of-band response fragment that re-renders the organizations, roles, and persons partials together after an organizations-related mutation (roles/persons flagged for OOB swap).

nodes.name: organizations_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX-swappable partial for CRUD of study Organizations, including type/country dropdowns with hidden decode fields and an add-organization form with full address fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Embedded JS keeps hidden `type_decode`/`addr_country_name` inputs in sync with the visible dropdown selections for both the add form and inline edit rows.

nodes.name: orgs_roles_persons.html
nodes.summary: Page combining the Organizations, Roles, and Persons management partials under a single study-scoped view.

nodes.name: persons_oob_response.html
nodes.summary: HTMX out-of-band response fragment that re-renders the persons and roles partials together after a persons-related mutation.

nodes.name: persons_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX-swappable partial for CRUD of study PersonName records (job title, family/given names, prefixes/suffixes) with an organization-link dropdown.

nodes.name: protocol_controlled_terminology.html
nodes.summary: Browse/search page for Protocol Controlled Terminology, offering filter fields (search, code, codelist name/code, limit), a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action, and paginated results table.
